prompt: A wide cinematic film still of an industrial production-planning control room. A large wall-mounted master-planning schedule board with a sliding metal time-fence track and blank perforated job-window cards sits off-centre, its brushed steel frame catching low raking light from a tall window on the left; deep shadows stretch across a concrete floor.
